purpose: Describe native event-margin occupancy and objective-gradient allocation on eight registered TRAIN images for source97, source97 with SW0143-T inference, and the completed SW0155 encoder_graph and joint checkpoints.

source.source_order: SW0155 train.source_contract() immutable 4096 ordered TRAIN IDs

objective.actual: Unmodified SW0155 objective.supervised_relation_loss on actual emitted-spike traces and the production TRAIN modal32 mask labels.
objective.membrane_proxy: Same relation objective with only component_spikes replaced by component_membrane; descriptive surrogate, not an emitted-spike loss or alternate training objective.

measurements.events: E=(component_membrane > 0.06*exp(b)); report full-window and settled-window (steps 512..1023) margin quantiles, event occupancy/transitions, gate-positive conditional occupancy, and exact S=E*g / shared-g checks.
measurements.gradients: Finite status, aggregate norm and unused parameter count by residual, graph, gamma-drive, Kuramoto, dendritic, membrane, integration scalars, and other native core; also input-tensor gradient norms for actual component spikes and membrane proxy.

guardrails: No optimizer, parameter update, checkpoint write, sweep, validation selection, or model-performance claim.
Validate actual SW0097 source order/assets, SW0143-T reference, and both completed SW0155 artifacts before GPU reservation.
Hash all parameters and buffers before/after each model; reject any mutation.

Immediately before child launch, recheck physical GPU UUID, zero compute owners, and at most 512 MiB use while holding the shared lease; on any query failure or changed admission, release and wait again.
A short diagnostic is descriptive and does not establish gate necessity, causal mechanism, or generalization.
